summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; keep private. Official API access and rate limits are evidenced, but commercial/public display, derivatives, caching, alerts, affiliate use, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rights are not. Current public terms point against the proposed use. Human counsel is required before any public data product, affiliate expansion, advertising, or interpretation of upstream rights.

Launch-readiness progress: the checklist and authoritative source review are complete, but none of the four legal data-use tasks can close. Source-rights evidence is insufficient because API documentation is not permission; data-flow, GA4 settings, vendor/DPA, retention, deletion, incident, and jurisdiction evidence remain open. Next evidence action: prepare an unsent written permission request identifying fields, storage, derivatives, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and commercial use; do not send or change the gate without owner approval.

Fleet compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary measured SEO work and blocked for any launch or monetization change lacking site-specific evidence. The baseline reports 37 passes, 16 fails, and 6 unknown across 59 checked sites; known failures include missing banner, accept, reject, GA4, privacy, or terms checks. Analytics is broadly available but has named GSC permission errors and unconfigured sites. Do not treat missing telemetry as zero or as a legal violation; require site-specific compliance evidence before material data-use changes.
